description: Flood extent series is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing and Regional and Rural Development. These datasets represent the approximate flood water inundation in their area of coverage. Refer to individual abstracts for more information. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing and Regional and Rural Development. It offers 19 resource(s) in rest, shp, tab, fgdb, kmz, gpkg, wms, xml. The portal shows 2025-07-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
